def Conjecture331.partialSum : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ :=
fun ψ N => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ψ (k + 1) / ↑(k + 1)

fun ψ => Filter.Tendsto (Conjecture331.partialSum ψ) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

fun a ψ α => {n | 0 < n ∧ |α - a / ↑n| < ψ n}
def Conjecture331.InfinitelyApproximable : ℝ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop :=
fun a ψ α => (Conjecture331.hitSet a ψ α).Infinite
def Conjecture331.LiteralClaim : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ → ℝ → Prop :=
